notes: Experimental diarization method, evaluated for research comparison against the production PyAnnote pipeline (see outputs/evaluations/der_results.json).

VBx requires externally supplied VAD; this run used MeetSense's existing Silero VAD segments (outputs/vad/speech_segments.json). PyAnnote's pipeline performs its own internal segmentation instead, so the two systems being compared do not receive identical segmentation input -- a genuine architectural difference, not an evaluation bias.
